note: Authority is granted per action; local readiness never implies a higher authority. Rows derive from governance/AUTHORITY.md and are validated against roles.json.

grants.evidence_expected: Complete ticket and truthful Project readback.
CONTRACT READY, explicit implementation scope, fresh base, exclusive paths, and a held writer lease.
Current ticket/Project evidence, risk/decision log, and recommendation; no technical assignment or integration mutation.
Exact invariant, schema/ID/lineage/version/compatibility evidence, affected paths, and smallest safe correction.
Decision packet and recorded answer, including Data Architecture clearance or exact authority for an exception to any WITHHOLD.
Frozen exact head and applicable gate contract; reviewer is a non-maker.
Itemized independence PASS, immutable exact head, required QA/gates, fresh base/head/PR/mergeability, unchanged scope, and recorded evidence.
Independence PASS plus current required review and CI. READY FOR MAIN creates no duty to deliver.
Gates A/B passed and fresh; exact SHA equality; true fast-forward; rollback/protection evidence; no blocking P0/P1 WITHHOLD or stale evidence. Non-release.
Separate action-specific exact-SHA decision, complete Gate-F promotion/rollback packet, and release runbook.
Gate D passed at the unchanged test SHA; exact build/artifact/flow evidence and known accepted defects.
Explicit action-specific authority; local readiness does not imply it.
Durable capture, exact targets, recovery consequence, and explicit authority.

evidence_expected_is_prose: What a grant expects before it is exercised, written for a person to read. It is deliberately NOT called required_evidence: that name means a list of evidence.json ids everywhere else in this corpus (promotion-gates, qa), and one name carrying two types is how a check that reads it generically ends up skipping the contract it cannot parse. A grant that should demand a specific receipt names it in the gate that guards the move, not here.
